authoring.note: A small residential building in The Flats, available to become a PC's home.

lore.summary: A small house in The Flats, the dense low grid behind the waterfront where the city stops climbing and simply repeats. A distinctive windowless grey structure stands two streets over -- nobody currently living on this row has ever found out what it actually is.
lore.playerFacing: Low-built and packed close against its neighbours, on a street indistinguishable from the next one except by number. The grey building down the road is the one thing anyone visiting actually remembers afterward.

hooks: The unexplained grey building two streets over is a standing, low-key curiosity -- something to investigate whenever the party actually has time to spare.
